description: Drops the level of a signal passing through on each trigger and lets it climb back, the sidechain pump without a compressor

params.text: Sets how deep the drop goes: fully anticlockwise the signal passes unchanged, fully clockwise each trigger takes it to silence
Sets how long the level takes to climb back, 50ms fully anticlockwise to 2 seconds fully clockwise
Fires a duck; a rising edge at the trigger jack does it too

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V fires a duck; the length of the gate makes no difference
The signal ducked here; with nothing patched the module puts out silence

notes: a CV input is bipolar and is added to its knob: 10V there is worth the knob's whole travel, -10V cancels a knob that is fully up, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
the module makes up some of the level it takes away, so at the middle of AMOUNT the un-ducked signal comes out about an eighth louder than it went in

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
